purpose: Quantify propagation of displayed input precision through the entire fixed analysis without choosing a method, subset, tolerance or source interpretation from results.
populations: All17 input rows, all3 outcome pools, all8 subgroup summaries and all4 between-group tests in every applicable perturbation. Never remove a row or subgroup.
methods: Exactly the original official RevMan5 Hedges correction/variance, DL, normalCI/p and subgroup-summary Q. All formula choices fixed from source before outcomes.
primary_point: Literal published mean/SD values and fixed analytic Ns. No input optimization or fitting to targets.
box_A: Each of68 displayed mean/SD coordinates is independently bounded by its literal half-unit. Exact Ns remain fixed.
box_B: Same complete box except the one printed integer SD2 is interpreted as2.0 with halfunit0.05. This is a separately reported full sensitivity, not a selectable primary alternative.

deterministic_control_design.single_coordinate_endpoints: Both endpoints of each68 coordinates;136 complete analyses per box.
deterministic_control_design.single_row_corners: All16 patterns of the4 fields for each17 rows, other rows nominal;272 complete analyses per box.
deterministic_control_design.global_endpoints: Alllower andallupper coordinates;2 complete analyses per box.
deterministic_control_design.joint_corners: First1024 points of scipy.stats.qmc.Sobol(d=68,scramble=False).threshold>=0.5 mapped to box endpoints; retain repeated patterns, no dedup/outcome pruning.
deterministic_control_design.joint_interior: First1024 uns scrambled Sobol points mapped linearly into full68-dimensional box.
deterministic_control_design.implementation_fix: Use qmc.Sobol(d=68,scramble=False).random_base2(m=10), fresh identical sequence per box. No Monte Carlo random seed.
deterministic_control_design.outputs: For every analysis retain all final g/CI/p/I2 and betweenQ/p/I2, every qualitative/significance classification and all original source-target comparison decisions. Stream records; no outcome-driven filtering.

summary: Report nominal comparisons, all sampled min/max and worst absolute departure per fixed final statistic, whole-analysis target compatibility, and exact source cases causing changed qualitative classifications. Sampled ranges are not certified global enclosures or probabilistic CIs.
strict_original_printed_diagnostics: All final and intermediate publication values are compared at their own literal half-printed-unit; strict inequalities remain strict. Complete strict diagnostics are mandatory supporting output, not separately required intermediate gates.
no_rescue: No sensitivity result can substitute for nominal data or rescue a failed mandatory primary comparison. All controls must complete and be independently audited even if nominal gates fail.
reason_uniform_tolerances_not_derived: A raw input tick has scale units, while SMD is dimensionless; pooling also changes DL heterogeneity and subgroup weights. Uniform .015 limits cannot be certified from raw precision alone without propagation, especially integer SD2. The initial pragmatic cap proposal is not a raw-error guarantee.
